notes.title: Trivia Throwdown is here!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who playtested and gave feedback.  We have done our best to make this a fun game with replay value.  We've also tried to quash any bugs that we've found, but please let us know if we've missed anything.*

Hope you all enjoy it :)
